entries.text_en: The Samsung Galaxy A36 5G is a mid-range smartphone that epitomizes Samsung’s commitment to delivering cutting-edge technology at an accessible price point. Announced alongside the Galaxy A56 5G and A26 5G in March 2025, this device was unveiled at the Mobile World Congress (MWC) in Barcelona and shortly after in India, reflecting Samsung’s strategic rollout of its Galaxy A series. Positioned as a bridge between affordability and performance, the Galaxy A36 5G features a 6.7-inch AMOLED display with a 120Hz refresh rate, ensuring smooth visuals for both everyday use and gaming. Powered by the Exynos 1480 chipset and paired with up to 8GB of RAM, it delivers reliable multitasking and 5G connectivity, catering to users who demand speed without breaking the bank. The device also boasts a versatile camera system, including a 50MP main sensor, a 12MP ultra-wide lens, and a 5MP macro camera, making it a strong contender in the competitive mid-range segment. Samsung’s focus on sustainability is evident with its use of recycled materials in the chassis, aligning with the growing consumer demand for eco-friendly electronics.

Samsung intègre également une démarche écologique en utilisant des matériaux recyclés pour son châssis, répondant à la demande croissante des consommateurs pour des appareils électroniques durables.
